title: 陈述语序

examples.en: Do you know where he lives?
Can you tell me how I can get to the station?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去车站吗？

guess.question: 从句里为什么是 where he lives，而不是 where does he live？

options.text: 宾语从句一律用陈述语序，助动词不能提到主语前面
options.feedback: 对！从句里永远是“主语 + 谓语”，does 这类助动词要去掉。

options.text: 因为主句已经是疑问句了
options.feedback: 不对——从句里本来就是陈述语序，跟主句是不是疑问句没关系。
不对——where does he live 放在从句里是错的。

rule.rule: 宾语从句一律用陈述语序：连接词 + 主语 + 谓语；原来疑问句里的 do / does / did 要去掉，时态体现在谓语动词上
rule.formula: ① 正确：I don't know where he is.　② 错误：I don't know where is he.　③ 去助动词：Where does he live? → where he lives　④ 去助动词：What did he say? → what he said

anchors.en: Can you tell me where the post office is?
anchors.zh: 你能告诉我邮局在哪儿吗？
anchors.note: the post office is 是陈述语序

anchors.en: Do you know when the train will arrive?
anchors.zh: 你知道火车什么时候到吗？
anchors.note: the train will arrive 不倒装

trap.wrong: Do you know where does he live?
trap.right: Do you know where he lives?
trap.why: 从句里要去掉助动词 does，时态体现在 lives 上。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——从句里主谓不倒装，does / did 一律去掉，把时态还给谓语动词。

options.distractor: 从句里 will 不能提到主语前
答语是将来时间，从句要用将来时
从句里去掉 does，且时态不对

check.explanation: 陈述语序 + 将来时：when he will come back。
where the bank is（陈述语序）。

options.text: I don't know what he wants.
I don't know what does he want.
I don't know what he want.
options.distractor: 主语 he 后动词要加 s

options.text: I don't know what want he.

check.explanation: what he wants（去掉 does，时态体现在 wants）。
